messages.subject: Whitford — execution version of settlement agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Vesey,

Please find the execution version of the settlement agreement, reflecting the agreed £185,000 ex gratia (first £30,000 tax-free), the 12-month PILON, the £750+VAT fees contribution, and the CEO-signed reference. Please arrange signature and the adviser's certificate; we will countersign for the Company on receipt.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Associate, Whitfield Carter LLP
